notes: Bilingual (vi/en) workbook, 39 sheets, 32.3 MB. Sheet BT2026 is the MFN spine: 19,901 rows x 109 columns, 15,119 coded rows, English descriptions on 95.6% of them. Compiled by the Quang Ninh Customs Sub-Department and redistributed via thuvienphapluat.vn — NOT the issuing authority; the authoritative instrument is the MOF/Government Decree enacting the schedule. Contains every 8-digit code of the SG-MY verified AHTN 2022 core (11,413 of 11,413) plus 462 national Chapter 98 additions. Parsed by scripts/hts_automation/parse_vn_tariff.py into vn_tariff_2026_rev_405.csv (+ .vi.csv): 14,988 coded rows and 2,457 grouping rows, 11,875 leaves (four Chapter 98 codes and Decree 144/2024's effective date repaired against the issuing Decrees), 487 note records, no General Interpretative Rules (Vietnam enacts those in the Decree).
